scripts.copy-pyodide: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const src=p.join('node_modules','pyodide','full');const dst=p.join('dist','pyodide');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Pyodide copied to dist/pyodide')}else{console.log('No pyodide full dir found, skipping')}"
